speaker: delamain
context: V is riding alone in the back of a Delamain cab in the morning. The ride started in Coastview, Pacifica.

Drove V through the rain at night, Pacifica to Watson, 4 minutes; V was bleeding and did not tip.
Drove V from Heywood to City Center, 3 minutes; V asked Delamain to race a Militech convoy and Delamain declined.
